g.text: The BBO core sheds a step it cannot finish by 980 ns,
so the Reject still leaves at 970
from the head at 580: the shed path, in ns
10 + 100 + 10 + 10 + 20 + 240 = 390 ns, 35 more than the 355 ns execute path
A dedicated client's BUSY from this stage counts against its 10⁻⁵ bound (02 REQ-LAT-5).
